top_signals.title: Google, Constellation Energy Deal; SpaceX Rises on Talks with NASA | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Option Care Health (OPCH) shares jumped after the Financial Times reports that McKesson and PE firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice are closing in on a deal to buy the provider of medical infusion services, that would value the business at more than $5b including debt.
- Constellation Energy (CEG) shares are higher on news Google and Constellation Energy announced a long-term deal to bring 890 MW of new nuclear capacity on the PJM grid in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
- SpaceX (SPCX) shares are the most actively traded in the premarket as NASA is close to announcing a bulk purchase of rocket launches to fuel its $30 billion drive to build a permanent base on the moon for humans to live and work. It also made Elon Musk a trillionaire once again. (Source: Bloomberg)
